FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Still curious? The brand and store are a course concept, so ordering and delivery are not available yet.

The fragrance

What is oasis?

Oasis is a concept for a plant-derived, alcohol-free perfume oil roll-on made to be worn close to the skin. It pairs fine fragrance with a brief personal pause.

What scents are in the collection?

Still Water blends lavender and bergamot; Palm Shade pairs sandalwood and vetiver; First Rain combines vetiver and mitti.

Is it a spray perfume?

No. Oasis is a roll-on perfume oil. Apply it directly to your wrists for a close-to-skin scent.

How much is in each bottle?

Each individual roll-on is 10 ml. The concept price is ₹799 per bottle. The discovery trio is priced at ₹549.

The ritual

How do I use it?

Roll on your wrists, bring your hands close to your face, and take three slow breaths. The ritual is designed to fit into a short pause during your day.

When can I use it?

Whenever you want a moment to yourself: at your desk, during a commute, or before a meeting.

Does oasis claim to treat stress or anxiety?

No. Oasis is a fragrance and a personal ritual. It is not a medical treatment or a replacement for care.

Ordering

Can I place an order now?

Not yet. This site is a branding and digital marketing course concept. The bag demonstrates the intended shopping experience, but checkout and payment are not active.

Where do you ship?

Shipping is not available while Oasis is a course concept. Delivery locations and policies would be published before a real launch.
